nodes.label: Context
nodes.plain_language: The stable frame that says what work is about and which Product, Project, Goal, Bounded Context meanings, consumers, subjects, and source policies apply.
nodes.claim: Context is a first-class identity distinct from DDD Bounded Contexts, requests, views, sessions, sources, and resolver operations.
nodes.scope: CyberAlchemy Product, Project, and Goal work contexts.
nodes.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 definitions-governance owner plus product owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not a DDD Bounded Context, Project, Goal, request, View, Session, source registry, or authority envelope.

nodes.label: CyberAlchemy
nodes.plain_language: The Product that frames every current CyberAlchemy Context.
nodes.claim: The Context package projects the existing Product identity without owning or redefining it.
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not product realization, market proof, release, or runtime.

nodes.label: Define Project
nodes.plain_language: The stable Project identity that coordinates Define work.
nodes.claim: The first Context belongs to the proposed Define Project.
nodes.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 product owner plus Define owners
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Context membership does not activate the Project or grant Project authority.

nodes.label: Define First-Class Ownership Goal
nodes.plain_language: The desired Define ownership result focused by the first Context.
nodes.claim: The first Context focuses on this draft Goal without achieving it.
nodes.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 product owner plus Define owners
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Context focus does not activate or achieve the Goal.

nodes.label: Define Shared Meaning
nodes.plain_language: The intended consumer named by the first Define Context.
nodes.claim: Define may consume a later resolved view without taking ownership of its sources.
nodes.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 product owner plus Define owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not an implemented Define runtime or proof of correct context use.

nodes.label: Define Shared Meaning Context
nodes.plain_language: The frame connecting CyberAlchemy, the Define Project, its ownership Goal, Governance meaning boundary, and the Define consumer.
nodes.claim: This draft Context preserves one Product-Project-Goal-purpose identity and one referenced Bounded Context across future source epochs.
nodes.scope: The first CAV2-D66 goal Context instance.
nodes.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 product owner plus Define owners
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not the Define Project, Goal, Bounded Context, request, View, source epoch, session, or authorization to implement.

nodes.label: CyberAlchemy Governance Bounded Context
nodes.plain_language: The domain boundary in which the Governance Ubiquitous Language has consistent meaning.
nodes.claim: The first Context references this existing Bounded Context without owning, merging, or redefining it.
nodes.scope: Projected DDD Bounded Context identity and boundary only.
nodes.owner_route: CyberAlchemy Governance owner plus Language Project owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not the CAV2-D66 Context, Product, Project, Goal, or a universal vocabulary boundary.

nodes.label: Exact Source Context Policy
nodes.plain_language: Use only named source selections and expose missing, stale, ambiguous, or conflicting material.
nodes.claim: The first Context source policy is fail-closed and creates no source authority.
nodes.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 product owner plus each source owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not a registry, source, owner acceptance, or automatic relevance judgment.

nodes.label: Preserve Context Integrity
nodes.plain_language: Keep Product, Project, Goal, Bounded Context meanings, purpose, consumer, source policy, lifecycle, and unresolved limits explicit.
nodes.claim: A Context must fail validation when its kind and anchors disagree, its Goal does not belong to its Project, or a Bounded Context reference is unresolved.
nodes.scope: Every candidate Context instance and its projections.
nodes.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 product owner plus Context instance owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Validation is not Context activation, Project or Goal lifecycle change, or execution authority.

nodes.label: Registry Context Project
nodes.plain_language: The stable Project identity that owns the Registry Context product, construction, runtime, and compatibility work.
nodes.claim: The second Context belongs to this proposed Project without treating its root folder as the Project.
nodes.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 Registry Context Project owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not the registry-context folder, Context instance, Goal, resolver process, or runtime authority.

nodes.label: Registry Context First Vertical Goal
nodes.plain_language: The desired result of proving the first deterministic Registry Context vertical.
nodes.claim: The second Context focuses this draft Goal without achieving it.
nodes.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 Registry Context Project owner plus runtime owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not the Context, implementation plan, runtime, passing test, or achieved result.

nodes.label: Resolve Registry Context
nodes.plain_language: Build one small current context view from named registries and explicit bindings.
nodes.claim: The Project names a Registry Context runtime owner for future implementation; this projected business capability remains unimplemented and unaccepted.
nodes.scope: Projected read, select, validate, bind, project, and explain capability identity only.
nodes.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 product owner plus CyberAlchemy v2 Registry Context runtime owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not an accepted runtime contract, source writer, owner decision, or implemented resolver.

nodes.label: Registry Context First Vertical Context
nodes.plain_language: The frame for building and proving the first Registry Context vertical.
nodes.claim: This draft Context connects one Product, Registry Context Project, first proof Goal, Governance meaning boundary, and Registry Context consumer while remaining distinct from each.
nodes.scope: The Registry Context Project's own CAV2-D66 goal Context instance.
nodes.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 Registry Context Project owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not the Project, Goal, Bounded Context, Registry Context specialization, request, View, root package, resolver process, or implementation authority.
